demos.name: Privilege Gateway Client Lab
demos.description: A client for a PingOne Privilege MCP gateway. Pick a door (all tools, some tools, none), discover its tools, run one and see the verdict first, then the evidence. Mock is a simulated gateway; Real uses your own door keys.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7833). Mock needs no tenant and no credentials. Docker: docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Real (owner-run) reads PGC_* settings from this lab's own .env. The repo is not assigned yet. The catalog id D144 is the owner's choice (2026-11-22, moved from D143, which ciba-approval-sequence-LAB holds); the content pack uses the same one.
